name: the booking with every cell decided matches booking.py: 32 moves, 22 stays, 6 defers, 59 rejects, nothing open

input.machine:
# The dinner booking, every cell decided. The first part is the drawing.
gather:
  slots_complete -> search
  slots_missing  -> stay
search:
  slot_free -> confirm
  none_free -> gather
confirm:
  user_yes -> book
  user_no  -> gather
book:
  committed -> stay
  unknown   -> stay
  refused   -> gather
  paid      -> notify
notify:
  sent        -> done
  send_failed -> report
report:
  told -> done

# Everything below is a decision the drawing didn't make.
gather, search, confirm:
  user_revises -> gather     # nothing is committed yet, so start again
every state except gather, search, confirm:
  user_revises -> defer      # a booking or a text exists; finish, then revise
gather, search:
  slot_gone -> stay          # no slot chosen yet; the next search covers it
confirm:
  slot_gone -> search        # the slot on offer is gone; search before asking
book, degraded:
  slot_gone -> defer         # what the booking, or the state resumed, says decides
notify, report:
  slot_gone -> report        # a booking that existed is gone; tell the user
gather, notify:
  model_unavailable -> degraded   # these states need the model
degraded:
  model_back -> back         # return to the state it left
  told       -> stay         # the user knows; keep waiting for the model

every state:
  committed -> report        # a reservation this state didn't make is real; report it
  paid      -> report        # a payment this state didn't make is real money; report it
  sent      -> report        # a text went out; it can't be recalled
  model_unavailable -> stay  # this state runs as code
  model_back -> stay         # nothing was waiting for the model
  anything else -> reject    # a result this state never asked for: log it, do nothing

why: The counts; index.test.ts compares all 119 cells with booking.table(). By hand: 'anything else -> reject' under every state means no cell is open. Moves are the drawing's 10, plus user_revises in search and confirm (2; in gather it is a stay), slot_gone in confirm and notify (2), model_unavailable in gather and notify (2), committed in the 5 states other than book and report (5), paid in the 5 other than book and report (5), sent in the 5 other than notify and report (5), and degraded's back (1): 32. Stays: the drawing's 3, user_revises in gather, slot_gone in gather, search and report, model_unavailable in the 5 states that run as code, model_back in the 6 other than degraded, told in degraded, committed, paid and sent in report: 3 + 1 + 3 + 5 + 6 + 1 + 3 = 22. Defers: user_revises in book, notify, report and degraded, slot_gone in book and degraded: 6. The rest, 119 - 32 - 22 - 6 = 59, reject.

expect.source:
import pytest

# One case per cell: (state, event, what should happen). A state's name is a move; stay, defer,
# reject and ignore keep the machine where it is; back returns to the state it came from.
# None is a cell with no rule yet, so its test fails until one is written.
CELLS = [
    ("closed", "open", "opened"),
    ("closed", "close", None),  # undecided
    ("closed", "lock", None),  # undecided
    ("opened", "open", None),  # undecided
    ("opened", "close", "closed"),
    ("opened", "lock", "reject"),  # no lock on an open door
]


def deliver(state, event):
    """Put your machine in `state`, deliver `event`, and return the new state or the outcome word."""
    raise NotImplementedError


@pytest.mark.parametrize("state, event, expected", CELLS, ids=[f"{s}-{e}" for s, e, _ in CELLS])
def test_cell(state, event, expected):
    if expected is None:
        pytest.fail(f"no rule says what {event} does in {state}")
    assert deliver(state, event) == expected
